summary: Cognex Corporation filed an 8-K on May 6, 2026 to report Q1 fiscal 2026 financial results and declare a quarterly cash dividend of $0.085/share, payable June 4, 2026 to holders of record May 21, 2026. The filing also notes the completed divestiture of the Japanese operations, a prior restructuring, and strong revenue/margin growth. No M&A, activist, tender, spin-off, or other special situation is present. The filing is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, not a special situation event.
